requirements.text: Carry the measured electric toothbrush with its head attached

provenance.statement: User measured 250–255 mm overall, nearly cylindrical 30 mm handle, 165 mm handle and 90 mm shoulder-to-tip

questions.criterion: Measured 255/30 mm brush individually clears shell and complete extraction opening with >=0.8 mm clearance; simultaneous packing separate
Actual attached brush fits, is accessible and avoids button activation

requirements.text: Carry toothpaste on its own side with room for tube variation

provenance.statement: User measured a new tube about 160 x 55 x 40 mm with 30 mm cap and requested margins for other versions

questions.criterion: Full 55 x 40 tube box individually passes the mouth with >=0.8 mm clearance after brush removal; no claim of simultaneous packing
User has tried the real brush and toothpaste together and confirms that diagonal placement works
Actual current and desired alternative full tubes fit without unwanted squeeze

requirements.text: Use a compliant printed design without a separate TPU print

provenance.statement: User requested compliance and preferably no separately printed TPU part

questions.criterion: Two connected cups; full-rim test is cropped from production in matching print orientation

Printed leaves operate, recover and withstand repeated use without cracks or creep

requirements.text: Provide a small or simplified fit test that is easy and quick to print alongside the full model

provenance.statement: User authorized both the small fit test and complete model in one phase

requirements.text: Make M1 minimal in design and occupied size

provenance.statement: User rejected earlier bulky designs and requested the most slim minimal suggestions; then selected M1

questions.criterion: 74.2 x 51.2 x 264 mm exterior: exactly 25 mm narrower than the previous model, two parts, no increased thickness; not a global minimum proof
User accepts complete size, proportions and handling as minimal

requirements.text: Separate cap with no exterior hinge and a rounded joint that resists opening when struck in a backpack

provenance.statement: User selected M1, accepted a separate cap, requested no exterior hinge, rounded overlap and resistance to popping open when hit in a backpack; authorized modelling

questions.criterion: Hard rim seats; deeper/wider catches lie at opposite widthwise ends and independently obstruct pull including +/-0.25 mm guide play; capture by 0.25 mm axial lift; removing hooks removes obstruction

Ten sampled precompressed squeeze-and-push poses clear; lap independently limits translation and twist; passive snap-on force not established
Actual loaded cap resists accidental bump, peel and pulling during backpack use while deliberate release remains comfortable

requirements.text: Protect the attached toothbrush and full toothpaste tube from outside backpack contents and pressure

provenance.statement: User said floss can travel elsewhere and the case mainly protects toothpaste and toothbrush from contact and crashes

questions.criterion: Actual loaded case protects items from external pressure and contact; no crush/drop rating assumed

provenance.statement: User asked for a support-free rounded R2/C combination

questions.criterion: Delivered matching STLs accepted by Orca under named PETG diagnostic profiles, with support-probe review explicit; not physical print or GUI STEP qualification
Actual ledges, bridges and vertical PETG leaf roots print successfully without supports

requirements.text: Reduce the previous M1 exterior width by 25 mm
